title: Mosaic runway price-shock origami model (Q3 2027)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, exploratory capacity + pricing sensitivity 'origami' model. The goal is to fold together headcount phasing, salary + burden, GPU capacity mix, and price-mix elasticity into a single notebook-like sheet to answer: how many months of runway do we preserve under price shocks and where are the hire cut points?

TL;DR (quick takeaways):
- Baseline (current pricing & planned hires) -> runway: 18.7 months.
- Moderate price shock (-10% list) w/ planned hiring freeze & selective delay -> runway: ~21.4 months (but product delivery risk).
- Severe price shock (-25% list) w/ 15% headcount deferral -> runway: ~14.1 months; requires immediate cost actions (GPU mix shift, quantization rollout, hiring freeze).
- Price upside (+15%) allows accelerate 6 engineering hires and fund 2 months of Dedicated capacity bursts.

Key assumptions (origami folds):
- Revenue mix: 60% hosted-api, 25% dedicated, 15% private (on-prem/VPC).
- Token growth: steady-state +12% q/q; high-variance scenario ±30%
- Average revenue per 1M tokens (baseline): $950
- Gross margin drivers: cost-to-serve per 1M tokens baseline $420 (GPU, infra, storage, egress)
- Salary + burden uplift: 1.42x on-base comp (taxes, benefits, equity ops pool)
- Hiring phasing: Q4-2026 hires are committed; Q1-Q3 2027 hires are proposed and can be deferred per scenario

Headcount plan and P&L sketch (salaries shown as annualized run-rate at mid-quarter):
Role | Base comp | Current FTEs | Q4-2026 hires | Q1-2027 plan | Q2-2027 plan | Notes
---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---
Eng (serving runtime) | $190,000 | 18 | +2 | +3 | +2 | focus on batching & quantization
Infra SRE | $160,000 | 7 | 0 | +1 | 0 | automation to reduce spot waste
Applied ML | $185,000 | 6 | +1 | +1 | 0 | model-mix evaluations
Product/Platform | $150,000 | 9 | +1 | +2 | +1 | console + rollout features
Sales/CS | $130,000 | 12 | 0 | +2 | +2 | enterprise onboarding support
Finance/Legal/People | $140,000 | 8 | 0 | 0 | 0 | hiring on cadence
Total FTEs (end of Q2-2027) | -- | 60 | +4 | +9 | +5 | ~78 FTEs total incl previous hires

Cost lines (annualized, illustrative):
- Salary + burden (current run-rate, annualized): $15.6M
- Cloud & GPU (variable + committed): $5.4M
- Dedicated leases (reserved capacity): $2.1M
- Tools & third-party: $0.9M
- Sales & marketing: $3.0M
- G&A: $1.2M
- Total OpEx baseline: ~$28.2M (annualized)

Origami scenarios (pricing sensitivity sweep):
We run 5 discrete scenarios: Upside (+15%), Baseline (0%), Down -10%, Down -20%, Tail -25%. For each scenario we adjust revenue forward and then apply operational mitigations in sequence (1: hiring freeze, 2: defer noncritical infra purchases, 3: shift GPU mix to higher-quantized models, 4: temporary slab pricing increases to enterprise).

Scenario table (months of runway left assuming $XM cash on hand = $46M as of 2026-10-31):
Scenario | Price delta | Immediate actions | Net OpEx change (yr %) | Runway months
---|---:|---|---:|---:|
Upside +15% | +15% | accelerate hires +6, add burst capacity | +4% (investment) | 23.5
Baseline | 0% | proceed as planned | 0% | 18.7
Down -10% | -10% | hiring freeze (defer Q1 hires), pause noncritical infra | -7% | 21.4
Down -20% | -20% | hiring freeze + defer Q1&Q2 hires, GPU mix shift | -18% | 16.2
Tail -25% | -25% | immediate 15% headcount deferral + contract renegotiation | -32% | 14.1

Sensitivity notes: these runways are elastic — small changes to cost-to-serve per 1M tokens have outsized runway impact. Example: raising cost-to-serve baseline from $420 -> $480 (14% increase) reduces baseline runway ~2.6 months.

Stitchpoints (decision triggers):
- If month-over-month net revenue delta < -6% for two consecutive months -> enact hiring freeze (defer all non-committed hires).
- If realized ARR loss > 12% vs plan in a quarter -> run emergency origami: immediate 10% headcount hold + reprioritize backlog to feature-critical only.
- If price shock persists > 3 months -> move to deeper actions (contract renegotiation, permanent role repricing, accelerated quant rollout).

What we can do quickly (low lift, high impact):
- Quantization rollout plan to shave ~12-18% off GPU cost on long tail models (owned by applied-ml + serving runtime). Ticket: JIRA-ML-214.
- Spot utilization automation (SRE) to recover ~6% of cloud bill within 8 weeks.
- SKU-based pricing experiment for 10% of new enterprise customers (A/B test) to measure elasticity.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Validate elasticity assumptions with 6 months of historical take-rate by cohort. (Priya to pull cohort analysis)
- Confirm committed Dedicated revenue cadence: are there backloaded enterprise deals that mask near-term shortfall? (Sales: Noah)
- Model risk: token growth scenarios are heavy-tailed; need Monte Carlo run rather than point scenarios. (Liam to spin up sim)
- Tax & equity ops backlog could create variance in burden rate; get HR payroll estimate for Q1 2027.

Appendix: quick Monte Carlo plan (next steps)
- Build 10k-run Monte Carlo varying: token growth (±30%), price elasticity (0.6–1.1), cost-to-serve (±20%), hiring cadence (binary per quarter). Outputs: distribution of runway months, P(under 12 months), expected hires deferred.

- jira: JIRA-FIN-987 (origami model skeleton), JIRA-ML-214 (quant rollout)
notes: Informal scratch/provisional inputs. Not a finalized forecast. Use for planning conversations and to drive a Monte Carlo run.
